basic_info.description: Charming and move-in ready, this light-filled 2BD/2BA home is situated on a serene corner lot in desirable Noe Valley. Fresh interior paint and newly refinished original wood floors highlight the home's vintage character and warm ambiance.  The main level features a spacious living room with cozy fireplace, formal dining room, and sunny eat-in kitchen. Just off the kitchen is a flexible bonus room perfect for a home office or sitting area with access to the backyard. A full bath completes this level.  Upstairs you'll find two generously sized bedrooms, both with excellent closet space, along with a second full bath and a linen closet. The expansive backyard is ideal for outdoor living and includes a large shed great for a workshop, studio, or storage as well as a gated parking area accessed from the side of the lot.  Prime location close to neighborhood shops, dining, parks, schools, tech shuttles, public transportation, and easy freeway access. A well-maintained Noe Valley classic!
